fullText.simplified:
第30章、相信

    藏花被抓住了，他的手脚被警察们死死地按住了。
    白林冲过来拿走了藏花手上的枪。他把包厚安从地上拉起来，再看了看手脚都被人按住的藏花。他似乎有话想说，但没有说出来。
    白林把枪还给了周局长。
    周局长高兴极了，“白林，谢谢你！要不是你让老何去办公室看我，我还被绑着！你怎么知道我出事了？”
    “我打电话到警察局，局里的人说你昨晚开车出去还没回来。”
    “哈哈，是的，我虽然有车，但不会开车，藏花不知道……”
    藏花的脸是红的，不是因为害怕，也不是因为紧张，而是因为气愤。他气愤地盯着包厚安，眼睛里好像有火。
    包厚安明白他为什么气愤。傲慢的藏花也许从来没有想过自己会被警察抓住。被人这样按住手脚，这种事情他还无法接受。
    包厚安的心情有点儿复杂。虽然他抓到了藏花，但是现在他一点儿也不激动。他看着地上的藏花，居然觉得有些难过。
    藏花的变装被洗掉了，他的脸变成了包厚安见过的样子。他的双手和双脚都被绑住了，但头一直抬得高高的。几个警察把他推上了警车。
    包厚安走到车前，隔着车窗问：“藏花，我再问一次，叶小七的笔是你送给他的吗？”
    藏花看着他，哈哈大笑起来，笑了很久才说了两个字：“你猜。”
    包厚安的脸色很不好看，藏花笑得更开心了。虽然被绑住手脚的人是藏花，但如果只看他们两个人的脸色，会让人觉得被绑的人是包厚安。
    警车向警察局开去，警察们跟在后面，高兴地欢呼。
    包厚安和白林站在院门口，看着远去的警车和警察，脸上都没有欢喜。
    “太危险了，如果藏花开枪怎么办？”白林问。
    “对不起，师父，是我不够沉稳，但我想他不会开枪的。”包厚安说。
    “你这么相信他？”
    “是的，我相信他。”
    白林叹息：“好吧，他确实没有开枪，看来你的相信是对的。虽然藏花奇怪又傲慢，但他身上有些东西和你很像。如果他不是小偷，也许你们会有另外一个故事。”
    包厚安说：“也许吧。也许我们会是朋友。”
    警车远去了。
    大盗藏花的故事结束了，但现在才九点，这一天还很长。侦探社里还有很多工作等着他们，还有很多新故事也等着他们。
    包厚安舒了一口气，说：“师父，走，我们回去！”
    白林笑了，“好，回去！”
fullText.traditional:
第30章、相信

    藏花被抓住了，他的手腳被警察們死死地按住了。
    白林衝過來拿走了藏花手上的槍。他把包厚安從地上拉起來，再看了看手腳都被人按住的藏花。他似乎有話想說，但沒有說出來。
    白林把槍還給了周局長。
    周局長高興極了，“白林，謝謝你！要不是你讓老何去辦公室看我，我還被綁著！你怎麼知道我出事了？”
    “我打電話到警察局，局裡的人說你昨晚開車出去還沒回來。”
    “哈哈，是的，我雖然有車，但不會開車，藏花不知道……”
    藏花的臉是紅的，不是因為害怕，也不是因為緊張，而是因為氣憤。他氣憤地盯著包厚安，眼睛裡好像有火。
    包厚安明白他為什麼氣憤。傲慢的藏花也許從來沒有想過自己會被警察抓住。被人這樣按住手腳，這種事情他還無法接受。
    包厚安的心情有點兒複雜。雖然他抓到了藏花，但是現在他一點兒也不激動。他看著地上的藏花，居然覺得有些難過。
    藏花的變裝被洗掉了，他的臉變成了包厚安見過的樣子。他的雙手和雙腳都被綁住了，但頭一直抬得高高的。幾個警察把他推上了警車。
    包厚安走到車前，隔著車窗問：“藏花，我再問一次，叶小七的筆是你送給他的嗎？”
    藏花看著他，哈哈大笑起來，笑了很久才說了兩個字：“你猜。”
    包厚安的臉色很不好看，藏花笑得更開心了。雖然被綁住手腳的人是藏花，但如果只看他們兩個人的臉色，會讓人覺得被綁的人是包厚安。
    警車向警察局開去，警察們跟在後面，高興地歡呼。
    包厚安和白林站在院門口，看著遠去的警車和警察，臉上都沒有歡喜。
    “太危險了，如果藏花開槍怎麼辦？”白林問。
    “對不起，師父，是我不夠沉穩，但我想他不會開槍的。”包厚安說。
    “你這麼相信他？”
    “是的，我相信他。”
    白林嘆息：“好吧，他確實沒有開槍，看來你的相信是對的。雖然藏花奇怪又傲慢，但他身上有些東西和你很像。如果他不是小偷，也許你們會有另外一個故事。”
    包厚安說：“也許吧。也許我們會是朋友。”
    警車遠去了。
    大盜藏花的故事結束了，但現在才九點，這一天還很長。偵探社裡還有很多工作等著他們，還有很多新故事也等著他們。
    包厚安舒了一口氣，說：“師父，走，我們回去！”
    白林笑了，“好，回去！”

sentences.simplified: 包厚安说：“也许吧。也许我们会是朋友。”
sentences.traditional: 包厚安說：“也許吧。也許我們會是朋友。”
sentences.pinyin: bāo hòu ān shuō yě xǔ ba yě xǔ wǒ men huì shì péng you
sentences.english: Bao Houan said, “Perhaps. Perhaps we would be friends.”

sentences.simplified: 警车远去了。
sentences.traditional: 警車遠去了。
sentences.pinyin: jǐng chē yuǎn qù le
sentences.english: The police car drove into the distance.

sentences.simplified: 大盗藏花的故事结束了，但现在才九点，这一天还很长。
sentences.traditional: 大盜藏花的故事結束了，但現在才九點，這一天還很長。
sentences.pinyin: dà dào cáng huā de gù shi jié shù le dàn xiàn zài cái jiǔ diǎn zhè yì tiān hái hěn cháng
sentences.english: The story of the great thief Cang Hua had finished, but it was currently only nine o’clock. Much of the day was still to come.

sentences.simplified: 侦探社里还有很多工作等着他们，还有很多新故事也等着他们。
sentences.traditional: 偵探社裡還有很多工作等著他們，還有很多新故事也等著他們。
sentences.pinyin: zhēn tàn shè lǐ hái yǒu hěn duō gōng zuò děng zhe tā men hái yǒu hěn duō xīn gù shi yě děng zhe tā men
sentences.english: There was still a lot of work at the detective agency waiting for them and also many new stories waiting for them.

sentences.simplified: 包厚安舒了一口气，说：“师父，走，我们回去！”
sentences.traditional: 包厚安舒了一口氣，說：“師父，走，我們回去！”
sentences.pinyin: bāo hòu ān shū le yì kǒu qì shuō shī fu zǒu wǒ men huí qù
sentences.english: Bao Houan let out a sigh of relief and said, “Master, come on, let’s head back!”

sentences.simplified: 白林笑了，“好，回去！”
sentences.traditional: 白林笑了，“好，回去！”
sentences.pinyin: bái lín xiào le hǎo huí qù
sentences.english: Bai Lin smiled: “Alright, let’s head back!”

sentence_translations: Chapter 30: Trust
Cang Hua has been captured. His hands and feet were firmly held down by the police.
Bai Lin rushed over and took the gun from Cang Hua’s hand.
He pulled Bao Houan up from the ground and then looked at Cang Hua, whose hands and feet were being held down.
He seemed to want to say something, but he didn’t speak.
Bai Lin returned the gun to Police Chief Zhou.
Police Chief Zhou was extremely happy:
“Bai Lin, thank you! If you hadn’t sent Old He to my office, I’d still be tied up! How did you know I was in trouble?”
“I called the police station. The people at the station said that last night you drove out and still hadn’t come back.”
“Ha ha, that’s right. Although I have a car, I don’t know how to drive. Cang Hua didn’t know that …”
Cang Hua’s face was red, not because he was scared and not because he was nervous, but because he was furious.
He furiously stared at Bao Houan. His eyes seemed to be on fire.
Bao Houan understood why he was furious. The arrogant Cang Hua perhaps never thought he would be caught by the police.
To have his hands and feet held down like this was a situation that he still could not accept.
Bao Houan’s emotions were a little complicated.
Although he had caught Cang Hua, right now, he wasn’t even the slightest bit moved.
He looked at Cang Hua on the ground and actually felt a bit sad.
Cang Hua’s disguise was washed off. His face was transformed into the appearance that Bao Houan had seen before.
His two hands and feet were tied down, but he held his head high the entire time. A few police officers pushed him into the police car.
Bao Houan walked in front of the car.
Through the window, he asked. “Cang Hua, I’m asking you one more time. Was it you who gave the pen to Ye Xiaoqi?”
Cang Hua looked at him and started laughing heartily. He laughed for a very long time before he finally said two words: “You guess.”
Bao Houan’s face looked awful. Cang Hua laughed even harder.
Although the person whose hands and feet were bound was Cang Hua, ..
.. if you just looked at their faces, you would think that the one who was bound was Bao Houan.
The police car headed for the police station. The police officers followed behind, happily cheering.
Bao Houan and Bai Lin stood by the gate of the yard. They looked at the police car and police officers heading into the distance.
There was no joy on their faces.
“It was too dangerous. What if Cang Hua opened fire?” Bai Lin asked.
“Sorry, Master. I was not calm enough. But I figured he wouldn’t shoot,” Bao Houan said.
“You trusted him that much?”
“Yes, I trusted him.”
Bai Lin sighed: “Alright, he indeed didn’t fire the gun. It seems you were right to trust him.
Even though Cang Hua is strange and arrogant, there are things about him that are very similar to you.
If he weren’t a thief, perhaps you two would have a different story.”
Bao Houan said, “Perhaps. Perhaps we would be friends.”
The police car drove into the distance.
The story of the great thief Cang Hua had finished, but it was currently only nine o’clock. Much of the day was still to come.
There was still a lot of work at the detective agency waiting for them and also many new stories waiting for them.
Bao Houan let out a sigh of relief and said, “Master, come on, let’s head back!”
Bai Lin smiled: “Alright, let’s head back!”
